name: iroh-quic-relay-fallback
purpose: Measure an Iroh/QUIC endpoint pair with IP transports disabled, using the public relay map and an explicit relay URL
steps: Build the pinned iroh 1.4.1 probe from research/iroh-probe on both hosts
Bind the server endpoint with RelayMode::Default and IP transports cleared
Record the assigned public relay URL and endpoint ID
Connect the macOS client by EndpointId plus that relay URL, with IP transports cleared
Echo bounded binary payloads on bidirectional QUIC streams
Close the connection and reconnect to measure setup cost
Fail if the selected path is not relay or if no relay address is present
